headline: Obama order creates a federal task force to plan restoration of the Gulf Coast's natural environment.
what_it_does: This executive order sets up a Gulf Coast Ecosystem Restoration Task Force. Based on its title, the task force is meant to organize efforts to restore the natural environment along the Gulf Coast. No summary was provided, so details about its members, powers, and duties are not described here.

who_it_affects.how: Agencies named to the task force would take part in planning and coordinating Gulf Coast restoration work.

who_it_affects.group: People and communities along the Gulf Coast
who_it_affects.how: Restoration plans developed by the task force would focus on the environment of the region where they live and work.
